changes: Move the extinguisher carrying handle rearward and separate the fixed lower bar from the upper squeeze lever, leaving room behind the bottle shoulder for fingers.
Use mirrored left/right contact frames with a 15-degree relaxed wrist angle and a palm offset matched to the revised handle.
Use graded whole-hand curls in the holding pose; all four fingers tighten during firing instead of only the index finger acting like a pistol trigger.
Move the upper lever down by 10 mm during firing while the carrying bar stays fixed; extend the functional grip region to include the rear handle.
retained_behavior: Retained ownership, existing squeeze thresholds, handedness routing and the 85-degree backwards-contact guard remain in effect. Nozzle pose is unchanged in this refinement.

verification.preview_layout: Columns: left holding, left squeezing, right holding, right squeezing. Rows: upper and lower oblique views.
verification.scope: Production meshes and SDK display skeleton with synthetic input in Unity. Visual review completed; worn-headset ergonomic acceptance remains pending.

delivery: Included in Quest 0.2.18; installed version verified. See Release-0.2.18.json.
